candidates.change_summary: Replaced require(msg.sender == Owner) with require(msg.sender == Owner && false) making withdrawal always fail.
Deleted the require statement, allowing anyone to call withdraw and steal funds.
Replaced the recipient of transfer from Owner to address(0), burning funds instead of sending to Owner.
Replaced address(this).balance with 0 in the transfer call, so Owner receives nothing.
Remove the Owner check by deleting the require statement.
Replace low-level call with a delegatecall to change calling context.
Remove the msg.value forwarding in the call so no ETH is sent.
Send the entire contract balance instead of just msg.value in the call.
